Settings of the Observability Engine

Source: R/symmetryDetection.R
reconstControl.Rd

Saturation and closed-form reconstruction settings for symmetryDetection(control = reconstControl()). Raise the caps to reconstruct wide or high-degree directions, at the cost of more samples.

Usage

reconstControl(
  relevanceCap = 6L,
  relevanceCapDir = 24L,
  relevanceCapSparse = 30L,
  degreeCap = 4L,
  sampleSlack = 5L,
  probeRetries = 8L,
  laurentDegNum = 4L,
  laurentDegDen = 2L,
  laurentCandCap = 200000L,
  termCap = 60L,
  generalDegNum = 4L,
  generalDegDen = 3L,
  gapOrderCap = 8L,
  minSupportCandCap = 20000L,
  perPrimeCap = 120L,
  perPrimeMinPrimes = 3L,
  homotopy = TRUE,
  timeout = Inf,
  homotopyDegree = NULL,
  degreeCapMax = NULL,
  exactProof = NULL,
  exactWorkCap = NULL,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

relevanceCap

Maximum number of coordinates in one entry of a direction for the dense fit; wider entries use sparse interpolation. Defaults to 6.

relevanceCapDir

Maximum number of coordinates in one direction; a wider one is reported by the support. Defaults to 24.

relevanceCapSparse

Maximum number of coordinates in one entry for the sparse (Ben-Or/Tiwari) fit; a wider entry is reported by the support. Defaults to 30.

degreeCap

Total degree bound of the dense rational fit. Defaults to 4.

sampleSlack

Number of samples beyond the minimum of the fit. Defaults to 5.

probeRetries

Number of retries of the relevance probe when a perturbation changes the pivots. Defaults to 8.

laurentDegNum, laurentDegDen

Numerator degree and monomial denominator degree bounds of the sparse Laurent fit. Default to 4 and 2.

laurentCandCap

Maximum number of candidate monomials of the Laurent and general sparse fits. Defaults to 200000.

termCap

Maximum number of terms of a sparse entry. Defaults to 60.

generalDegNum, generalDegDen

Numerator and denominator degree bounds of the general sparse rational fit. Default to 4 and 3.

gapOrderCap

Maximum order of the power series in the time between events. Defaults to 8.

minSupportCandCap

Maximum number of column subsets searched for directions with small support. Defaults to 20000.

perPrimeCap

Maximum number of samples per prime for the reconstruction under equilibrate = TRUE. Defaults to 120.

perPrimeMinPrimes

Minimum number of primes with samples for a reconstruction under equilibrate = TRUE. Defaults to 3.

homotopy

Whether directions still open under equilibrate = TRUE are fitted along lines in parameter space as a last route. Defaults to TRUE.

timeout

Time limit in seconds for the reconstruction. Directions not finished in time are reported by their support. Inf (default) sets no limit.

homotopyDegree

Total degree bound of the entries the homotopy route fits.

degreeCapMax

Degree up to which an entry past degreeCap is probed again, the bound doubled each time.

exactProof

Whether a closed form that differs from the lift of the form is proven through the fields of each regime, one detection per regime.

exactWorkCap

Work bound of that proof: regimes times coordinates times tape instructions; above it the proof is skipped and the limit noted.

seed

Seed of the random choices.

Value

A list of class reconstcontrol with the settings.

Details

homotopyDegree, degreeCapMax, exactProof, exactWorkCap and seed default to NULL, which keeps the value of symident (4, 8, TRUE, 500000 and 0).

See also

symmetryDetection()

reconstControl(degreeCap = 6L, timeout = 60)
